title: Nonvanishing higher Specht polynomials and a construction for three row and hook shape Garsia--Procesi modules
summary: Given a polynomial ring quotient $R=\mathbb{C}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]/I$ with an action of the symmetric group induced by permuting the variables, a higher Specht basis is a collection of bases for each irreducible $\mathfrak{S}_n$-module in its decomposition that mimics the behavior of the classical Specht polynomial construction in the lowest degrees. Higher Specht bases have now been constructed for the coinvariant ring, the full polynomial ring, the rings $R_{n,k}$ appearing in the $t=0$ Delta conjecture, the hook shape Garsia-Haiman modules, and the two-row Garsia-Procesi modules, and more.
